mechanism: CAACP-HQKV v2 (ANTI-LOCK) — same hyperbolic dual-branch SAT-style QKV as Run8 v1, but with three INDEPENDENT gated residuals and a NON-ZERO gamma init so the module actually enters the network

why_this_run.run8_finding: CAACP-HQKV never entered the network. Measured on all 4 datasets of BOTH H1_HYP and H2_EUC: [HQKV-GAMMA] detail ~= +/-5e-41, global=0, lite=0, and [HQKV-DIAG-*] contrib_norm == 0.0, branch_out_ratio_db == 0.0. F1 was identical to CTRL within noise (CDD 0.9776/0.9777/0.9777, LEVIR 0.9121/0.9116, SYSU 0.8188/0.8173, WHU 0.9434/0.9418).
why_this_run.run8_verdict: NO-OP (invalid control), NOT a mechanism refutation. The euclidean counterfactual H2 measures the same nothing, so the curvature gate could never be tested.
why_this_run.root_cause: gamma zero-init + multiplicative gate is SELF-LOCKING: r = gamma*Delta => dL/dgamma = <dL/dr, Delta>; with gamma=0 we have r=0 so dL/dr is multiplied by 0 on the way back => dL/dgamma = 0 identically. Verified numerically in models/test_run8b_antilock_precheck.py C5: gamma=0 => contrib_norm == 0 AND all three gamma grads == 0.
two_extra_structural_bugs: gamma_lite never entered the forward pass at all: stage0 output came from lite_fuse but was multiplied by gamma_detail
gamma_global never entered the forward pass either: the detail and global attention outputs were summed (o = a + b) BEFORE the single gamma_detail multiplication

fix_under_test.1_rms_normalize_per_branch: each branch output is normalized to unit RMS, so |Delta| no longer depends on gamma and dL/dgamma is non-zero from step 1
fix_under_test.2_three_independent_gated_residuals: r = gamma_detail*Delta_detail + gamma_global*Delta_global + gamma_lite*Delta_lite; every gate enters the forward pass
fix_under_test.3_nonzero_gamma_init: gamma_init = 0.5 by default (frozen for this campaign); a fixed structural 1/sqrt(n_branch*n_stage) scaling keeps the injected RMS at ~0.5 (backbone features are unit-variance after LayerNorm2d)
fix_under_test.explicitly_NOT_done: we do NOT re-normalize the final sum: that would divide gamma out of the output and cut dL/dgamma again (the same self-lock in disguise). Recorded because the first attempt made exactly that mistake.

pretraining_discipline_tradeoff.v1_claim: gamma=0 => epoch-0 is bitwise identical to the model without the module
pretraining_discipline_tradeoff.v2_position: ABANDONED. Zero-init on a multiplicative gate is self-locking. Replaced by a stronger, directly observable proof: [PRETRAIN-LOAD] worst_diff == 0 (212/222 VMamba keys bitwise).
pretraining_discipline_tradeoff.consequence: epoch-0 is NOT bitwise identical to CTRL_R8. All four gates are non-zero at init, so the module contributes a real ~0.5-RMS perturbation from the first step. CTRL_R8B (hqkv=0) remains the same-wave control.

failfast.behavior: if contrib_norm < 1e-3 the run raises SystemExit(3); the orchestrator does NOT retry and the pipeline stops the whole campaign. Rationale: Run8 burned 4+ full 80K runs before anyone noticed contrib_norm was 0.

variants.name: B1_HYP
variants.role: MAIN: anti-lock hyperbolic dual-branch SAT-QKV + injection

variants.name: B2_EUC
variants.role: MANDATORY curvature counterfactual (identical radial quantities, tangential distance)

budget.gpu_layout: GPU0 only, four datasets SERIAL (GPU1 carries the exploration line, owned by another session; never touched)

acceptance_criteria.primary: four-dataset test F1 vs same-wave CTRL_R8B
acceptance_criteria.accept: B1_HYP has F1 >= CTRL_R8B on >=3/4 datasets AND SYSU F1 strictly greater, with all mechanism self-checks (including the anti-lock gates) passing
acceptance_criteria.curvature_requirement: B1_HYP must beat B2_EUC with the same sign on >=3/4 datasets before ANY claim that negative curvature is necessary
acceptance_criteria.if_B1_ge_CTRL_but_B1_approx_B2: conclusion becomes 'local radial structural evidence helps'; the hyperbolic/curvature story must be dropped
acceptance_criteria.if_B1_le_CTRL_but_antilock_gates_pass: MECHANISM-FAIL — this time it IS a genuine refutation, because the module demonstrably entered the network
acceptance_criteria.if_antilock_gates_fail: INVALID — the fix did not work; do not interpret the F1 numbers

mechanism_selfchecks: [HQKV] gamma_init == 0.5 (all three gates non-zero at construction)
[HQKV-GRAD] step=1 gamma_grad detail/global/lite all > 0 (the direct anti-lock proof)
[FAILFAST] step=1000 contrib_norm > 1e-3 (else the run aborts with rc=3)
[HQKV-DIAG] per-epoch contrib_norm > 0 and shares sum to ~1
real-batch train<->deploy 0.5 binary disagreement == 0 (or Run7 7.6 knife-edge)
[ACTUAL-OPT-STEPS] 80000 inside the LAST complete TEST block

known_risks.R1_antilock_changes_epoch0: epoch-0 is no longer bitwise identical to CTRL_R8B. Disclosed; the pretrain proof is now worst_diff==0 instead.
known_risks.R2_curvature_may_be_rank_equivalent: CPU precheck measured Kendall tau(H, E) = 0.9983 on random features. If that holds on real features, B1 ~= B2 and the curvature claim dies. B2_EUC exists to catch this.
known_risks.R3_injection_precedent_failed: Run7 E10 (aux_inject) did not beat E9 (aux_only). Run8b's injection is a change-aware cross-scale aggregation, not an edge head, but this is not evidence it will work.
known_risks.R4_casaa_precedent: CASAA was terminated with 'deployable routing ranking improvement != F1 improvement'.
known_risks.R5_gamma_may_run_away: with a non-zero init and unit-RMS branches, gamma could grow instead of shrinking and dominate the backbone. The fixed 1/sqrt(n) scaling bounds the INITIAL RMS, not the final one, so the per-epoch [HQKV-DIAG] gammas/contrib_norm trace must be watched.
known_risks.R6_gpu_contention: GPU1 carries another session's exploration work. GPU_ID is pinned to 0; the supervisor only observes GPU1.
